narrationTexts: Confirms the bug in `orderTotal`: it taxes the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount, and double-rounds. Fixing now.
finalText:
**Fixed. Suite is green: 625 passing, 0 failing.**

`orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:39](src/pricing.js:39) was taxing the pre-discount amount and double-rounding. Now it taxes the discounted total, rounded once, matching the spec.

Next: nothing.
